integrity: The Nijenhuis equations and automorphism action are reconstructed directly. Exhaustive finite-field conjugacy computations are replay evidence for the symbolic normal-form proof.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two is excluded from the component and orbit theorem.
The theorem concerns one three-dimensional nilpotent associative algebra.
Prior work already classifies the raw complex Nijenhuis families; the new scope is the automorphism quotient and finite-field arithmetic.
title: Automorphism normal forms for Nijenhuis operators on the commutative three-dimensional nilpotent algebra
